title: hYYa Footprint Inspector
shortDescription: Bona okwaziwa ama-app ngawe, ukulungise kalula. Kumahhala futhi kuyimfihlo.
fullDescription:
Ama-app akho angathola ulwazi oluningi ngawe ukudlula ucabanga. I-hYYa Footprint Inspector ikukhombisa ngamagama alula lokho angafunda ngakho, abangakubuka, nokuthi ungakulungisa kanjani lokho.

IZINYATHELO EZINE EZILULA
1. Umkhondo wedijithali: ngokuthepha kanye nje, hlola lokho noma yiliphi i-app elingakufunda mayelana nedivayisi yakho nomkhondo wayo (device fingerprint).
2. Ama-app abucayi: bona ukuthi yimaphi kuma-app akho abanye abangawabona, njengama-app okuthandana, okukholwa, ezempilo noma ama-VPN, nokuthi lokho kungadalulani ngawe.
3. Abalandeleli (trackers): bona ukuthi yimaphi ama-app angafunda isikrini sakho, afunde zonke izaziso, noma akhiye idivayisi yakho. Ama-app analezi zimvume zama-app ezingaphezu kweyodwa ayaphawulwa, ngoba yindlela ama-app okuqapha asebenza ngayo. Bese uvula irekhodi le-Android uqobo elikhombisa ama-app asebenzise indawo yakho, ikhamera nombhobho.
4. Ukuhlola ubumfihlo: vikela idivayisi yakho kuma-app angafuneki ngezibuyekezo, ukuqalisa kabusha idivayisi maviki onke nokuhlola amaphasiwedi avunyelwe, bese ubuyekeza kokuthi Izilungiselelo (Settings) zakho indawo ngayinye ngesikhathi futhi ubuyise izimvume zama-app ongafuni ukuzinikeza.

ISIKOLO ESISODWA SAKHO KONKE OKUNE
Isikolo sakho sokuhlola ubumfihlo, ezingeni le-100, sihlanganisa lokhu kuhlola okune ndawonye. Uma siphezulu kungcono, futhi siyenyuka njengoba uqeda ukuhlola ngakunye.

KULUNGISE NAMI
Thepha u-"Kulungise nami" bese i-app ikuhola kusixazululo ngasinye, ngasinye ngesikhathi, ikuvulele ngqo ingxenye efanele kokuthi Izilungiselelo. Bese uhlola futhi ubone isikolo sakho sikhuphuka.

KUCACILE, KUQONDILE FUTHI KUNOKWETHEMBEKA
• Ishadi lemibala ekhasini ngalinye: obomvu kumele ubhekwe, ophuzi kumele uwazi, oluhlaza kulungile.
• Konke okutholakele kusezingeni eliqondile: isihloko esifushane, umugqa owodwa ochaza ukuthi kungani kubalulekile, nendlela yokukulungisa.
• Ama-app akhelwe ngaphakathi kudivayisi yakho awaphawulwa, kanti ama-app okulawula kwabazali noma awomsebenzi abizwa ngalokho ayikho ngempela.
• Impendulo eqotho ethi "i-Google kuphela noma umenzi wedivayisi ongalungisa lokhu" lapho kungekho lutho ongakwenza.
• Isikhumbuzi samaviki onke noma senyanga sokuhlola futhi, uma usifuna.

UKUBONAKALA NOMA USULUSUSILE I-APP
I-Android inika ama-app enkampani ngayinye ikhodi ehlala injalo noma ngabe uyalisusa bese ulifaka kabusha. Bona eyakho, nokuthi kungani ukusetha kabusha kwasefekthri kuphela okungayishintsha.

UBUMFIHLO NGOKOMKLAMO
• Ayikho imvume ye-inthanethi: i-app ayikwazi ukuxhuma noma kuphi, ngakho akukho lutho oluphuma kudivayisi yakho.
• Ayikho i-akhawunti, azikho izikhangiso, akukho ukulandelela.
• Kumahhala. Akukho ukuthenga, akukho okubhaliselwe.
• I-open source, ngakho noma ubani angahlola ukuthi isebenza kanjani.

Hlangana nomphenyi: usesigabeni ngasinye futhi unamathiphu uma umthepha.

I-hYYa Footprint Inspector iyingxenye yomndeni we-hYYa wama-app abeka ubumfihlo phambili.
releaseNotes:
• Okusha: isikolo esisodwa sobumfihlo sokuhlola okune, amagama aqondile, nezinyathelo ezintsha zokuvikela kuma-app angafuneki okuqapha.
Lokhu kukhishwa kuqukethe ukulungiswa kwamaphutha ajwayelekile nokuthuthukiswa kokuzinza.
